collection.title: Skoda Superb Saloon 2008 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Skoda Superb Saloon 2008 to 2015 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
